_readme: No verified certificate names, issuing bodies or years were available when this site was built — do NOT invent them. Each item below is a real image slot with an editable placeholder name. Once you have a verified certificate: replace 'name', 'issuer' and 'year' with the real values, drop the certificate image into /assets/images/certificates/ using the same filename (or update 'image'), and re-run scripts/build_site.py. To add certificate #5, copy one object inside 'items' and give it a unique image.
